caption: The drawing shows a hand-operated loom constructed primarily from brown wood, with a rectangular wooden base supporting vertical and horizontal wooden beams. A horizontal wooden rod at the front holds black and brown spools of thread, with black thread extending across the frame towards the back. Various vertical threads, likely white or cream, pass through the center of the structure, held in place by a wooden heddle frame consisting of a rectangular piece with a slot in the middle. The loom features a pulley mechanism near the top, attached to several cords or strings that hang vertically. At the rear, another horizontal rod holds a large spool of white or off-white thread. Two wooden rods extend outward from either side of the loom's base, parallel to the ground. The overall composition places the loom at an angle, showing details of the structure and components arranged on a light, plain background.
title: Shaker Hand Loom
